sources.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: render-locked four-view architectural construction board for a CityPrompt LEGO building variant
Primary request: Design one coherent, physically buildable Intermodal Transit Hub - Sculptural Steel Exoskeleton from the catalogue contract below and show that exact same building in four equal panels in a precise 2 by 2 grid.
Panel 1: dead-front orthographic elevation, complete building visible. Panel 2: pedestrian-height front-right architectural survey oblique. Panel 3: rear-left oblique proving every material and structural system wraps the secondary elevations. Panel 4: high aerial roof-plan oblique proving roof topology, courts, spans, and equipment.
Catalogue contract: A glazed intermodal concourse is sheltered by two immense parabolic white-steel arches and a continuous fan of branching ribs, all landing on visible structural shoes above a warm brick-and-glass plinth; the luminous central nave remains open from entry to platforms.
Building lock: 100 m by 62 m, three public levels; a complete glazed nave and lower brick plinth sit beneath two longitudinal parabolic arches, twenty-four paired fan ribs connect arch nodes to real perimeter shoes, roof glazing spans between ribs, and the central entry and platform axis remains unobstructed.
Scene/backdrop: clean warm-light-grey architectural studio ground and backdrop, no neighbors, trees, cars or people.
Style/medium: premium photoreal architectural survey photography and physically plausible construction reference, not concept art.
Lighting/mood: neutral bright overcast survey illumination with soft contact shadows and controlled glass reflections, consistent in every panel.
Materials/textures: satin white structural steel ribs and cast nodes; warm red-brown civic brick plinth; clear low-iron concourse glass; silver pressure caps; pale terrazzo platform deck; warm occupied station depth; translucent ETFE and glass roof strips.
Constraints: exact same coherent building topology, storey datums, structural bays, openings, entrances, material zones and roof in all four panels; credible load paths; real recessed openings and physical screens; thin neutral gutters; whole building in every frame; no labels, text, signs, logos or watermark.
Avoid: generic airport box, loose decorative ribs, ribs ending in mid-air, sealed central nave, blue mirror glass, identical simple barrel vault, opaque roof; perspective distortion, blank sides, changed geometry between panels, entourage, dramatic sunset.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: shadow-neutral 3 by 2 construction and occupied-depth material board for the exact Intermodal Transit Hub - Sculptural Steel Exoskeleton shown in Image 1
Input images: Image 1 is the approved four-view geometry, palette, construction-scale and optical authority.
Primary request: Create six equal square straight-on orthographic samples in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid separated only by thin neutral-grey gutters, with no labels.
Top-left: satin white structural steel rib and node, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no facade or opening.
Top-center: warm red brown civic brick plinth, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete building element.
Top-right: pale terrazzo platform and stair, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete ornament assembly.
Bottom-left: silver aluminum curtain-wall cap, authentic construction scale and fine micro-detail, no complete frame, door or screen.
Bottom-center: neutral low-iron concourse glass plus clean occupied depth seen dead-on, with clear floor, ceiling and restrained warm occupation, no exterior frame, mullion, screen, facade or skewed perspective.
Bottom-right: translucent ETFE and laminated roof glass, authentic construction scale and evenly lit, no complete roof scene.
Scene/backdrop: flat evenly lit material-capture setup. Style/medium: premium physically based photoreal architectural construction texture reference.
Lighting: diffuse neutral overcast capture; no directional sunlight, baked shadow, vignette or perspective.
Constraints: exact 3 by 2 grid; every sample fills its cell edge-to-edge; no labels, text, logos or watermark; no complete facade or repeated window grid; match Image 1 exactly.
Avoid: cartoon materials, generic substitutions, oversized motifs, blue mirror glass, dramatic lighting, building perspective, decorative border.
